mapper.select: SELECT id, slug, title, description, duration_text, price, active, category, created_at FROM fortunes WHERE active = true ORDER BY id

SELECT f.id, f.slug, f.title, f.description, f.duration_text, f.price, f.active, f.category, f.created_at FROM fortunes f LEFT JOIN fortune_results r ON r.slug = f.slug AND r.status = 'DONE' WHERE f.active = true GROUP BY f.id ORDER BY COUNT(r.id) DESC, f.id LIMIT 5
SELECT id, slug, title, description, duration_text, price, active, category, created_at, teaser_prompt, full_prompt, ui_config FROM fortunes WHERE slug = #{slug}
SELECT id, slug, title, description, duration_text, price, active, category, created_at, teaser_prompt, full_prompt, ui_config FROM fortunes ORDER BY id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fortunes (slug, title, description, duration_text, price, active, category, teaser_prompt, full_prompt, ui_config) VALUES (#{slug}, #{title}, #{description}, #{durationText}, #{price}, #{active}, #{category}, #{teaserPrompt}, #{fullPrompt}, #{uiConfig})
mapper.update: UPDATE fortunes SET title = #{title}, description = #{description}, duration_text = #{durationText}, price = #{price}, active = #{active}, category = #{category}, teaser_prompt = #{teaserPrompt}, full_prompt = #{fullPrompt}, ui_config = #{uiConfig}, updated_at = now() WHERE slug = #{slug}
